title: ConfigGuestDataVisibilityDocument
description: Server-only platform setting stored at config/guestDataVisibility. groupSizeFloor is the smallest group of guests who came for which an organiser sees an event's catch, match or chat counts; below it they read as zero and add to no total or trend. With no document the floor is 10. Any other shape also reads as 10, because a privacy floor that cannot be read fails closed. functions/src/analytics/guestDataVisibility.ts parses exactly this shape.
x-owner: the owner in the Firebase console (Admin credentials); read by getHostAnalytics

groupSizeFloor.description: Smallest group of guests who came for which organisers see dating counts. Default 10.

reason.description: Why the floor is set, for the next reader.
